steps.text:
Hey team! 👋  

Just a quick reminder to please take a moment to update your on‑call availability in the schedule. Keeping it current helps us make sure the right folks are notified when things come up and keeps our service running smoothly.  

You can edit your availability in the on‑call board (or the Ops calendar) at your convenience. Thanks for staying on top of it! 🙏  

If you have any questions or run into issues, feel free to ping me. Have a great day! 🎉
